title: Differentially Private Statistical Inference for Rankings from Pairwise Comparisons
abstract: arXiv:2611.13485v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable inference for rankings of large language models based on human pairwise comparisons must preserve the privacy of individual preference records. To meet this need, we develop methods for score and rank inference under the Bradley-Terry model with edge differential privacy. For an objective-perturbed estimator, a new leave-one-out analysis establishes finite-sample bounds on Euclidean and entrywise estimation errors. For sufficiently dense comparison graphs, the error bounds extend to smaller privacy budgets, including regimes in which its privacy term dominates its statistical term. A uniform asymptotic expansion yields asymptotically valid confidence intervals for individual scores and pairwise score differences. To improve finite-sample performance, we account for both regularization bias and privacy-induced randomness by combining a plug-in ridge-bias correction with Gaussian-Laplace calibration. translated_title: 基于成对比较的排名的差分隐私统计推断
translated_abstract: 基于人类成对比较的大语言模型排名的可靠推断必须保护个体偏好记录的隐私。为满足这一需求，我们在Bradley-Terry模型下开发了具有边差分隐私的分数与排名推断方法。针对目标扰动估计器，一种新颖的留一分析建立了欧几里得范数和逐元素估计误差的有限样本界。对于足够稠密的比较图，这些误差界可延伸至更小的隐私预算，包括隐私项主导统计项的情形。一致渐近展开为个体分数以及成对分数差异提供了渐近有效的置信区间。为改善有限样本性能，我们通过将即插即用的岭回归偏差校正与高斯-拉普拉斯校准相结合，同时考虑了正则化偏差和隐私引入的随机性。我们进一步建立了自助法（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文首次在Bradley-Terry模型框架下实现了边差分隐私下的排名统计推断，通过留一分析给出有限样本误差界、渐近有效置信区间以及结合岭偏差校正与高斯-拉普拉斯校准的偏差修正方法，适用于保护隐私的大语言模型成对比较评估。
en_tdlr: This paper develops differentially private statistical inference for rankings under the Bradley-Terry model from pairwise comparisons, providing finite-sample error bounds via leave-one-out analysis, asymptotically valid confidence intervals, and bias-corrected estimators for privacy-preserving LLM evaluation.
